_what: Every interface string, in both languages, in one file. Product names and product descriptions are NOT here — those live in data/menu.json and come from the client. Nothing here describes a product, claims anything about the shop, or states a fact (address, hours, price) that has not been given to us. Page HEADLINES AND PROSE are not here either: the client has approved none of them, so they live in data/copy-draft.json and render behind a visible Borrador / Draft chip.
